ns0:problem.ns0:para: For the function f(x)=2x2+3x−1, evaluate the function.

ns0:table.aria-label: f of x = 2 x squared plus 3 x minus 1. To evaluate f of 3, substitute 3 for x. f of 3 = 2 times 3 squared plus 3 times 3 minus 1. Simplify. f of 3 = 2 times 9 plus 3 times 3 minus 1. f of 3 = 18 plus 9 minus 1. f of 3 = 26.

ns0:table.aria-label: f of x = 2 x squared plus 3 x minus 1. To evaluate f of negative 2, substitute negative 2 for x. f of negative 2 = 2 times the quantity negative 2 in parentheses squared plus 3 times negative 2 minus 1. Simplify. f of negative 2 = 2 times 4 plus negative 6 minus 1. f of negative 2 = 1.
